description: Generate concise investor reports for Solum Health. Pulls metrics from Google Sheets, analyzes customer conversations from Fireflies, and produces a structured DOCX report matching the investor update template. Use this skill when the user says "investor report", "investor update", "monthly report for investors", "board update", "generate investor deck", "how are we doing this month", or any variation of wanting a periodic investor-facing summary. Default period: previous calendar month. User can specify a different period.
